summary: Analysis stage is approved. The analysis identifies the relevant files, existing SUN-only behavior, DB/API contracts, security boundaries, architecture conflicts, regression risks, and validation expectations without silently changing the approved plan.
warnings: The analysis intentionally leaves static-token spam/rate limiting as a documented residual risk; that is consistent with the approved scope and not a blocker.
evidence: Reviewed mandatory rules in .ai/reviewer/REVIEWER.md and required artifacts request.md, plan.md, todos/TODO-001.md, todos/TODO-002.md, and analysis.md.
Confirmed current /api/tag only accepts SUN {e,c}; token-only and uid-only bodies return 400 before DB access in src/app/api/tag/route.ts:11-18.

Confirmed old public.record_tag has both token and UID fallback paths in supabase/migrations/20260927120000_init.sql:125-180, supporting the analysis decision to add a new token-only function instead of reusing it.
Confirmed record_sun_tag ordering, team row lock, SUN counter uniqueness, baseline check, race messages, event insert shape, and grants in supabase/migrations/20260927140000_sun.sql:28-157.

Confirmed get_team_race_data returns full session and tag rows while app mappers narrow participant-facing data in supabase/migrations/20260927120000_init.sql:393-424, src/lib/db.ts:135-152, and src/lib/race.ts:181-200.
Confirmed toTagSummary strips token/uid/baseline from /api/tag success data in src/lib/db.ts:64-70.
Confirmed admin live data includes tag tokens only behind admin API auth in src/app/api/admin/sessions/[id]/route.ts:6-14 and src/lib/db.ts:155-174.
Confirmed /t/[token] currently branches on isAdmin and mounts either admin SUN panel or participant landing, with no static token lookup yet, in src/app/t/[token]/page.tsx:16-19.
Confirmed participant landing currently sends nothing for non-SUN URLs and shows the current no-SUN message in src/app/t/[token]/participant-landing.tsx:47-53.
Confirmed /race currently submits only SUN params and discards non-JSON/legacy pending values in src/app/race/page.tsx:85-131.
Confirmed Next.js 16 docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs show params/searchParams are Promises and searchParams is a request-time API that opts dynamic rendering, matching the analysis assumptions.
regressions_checked: Switch-off behavior preservation: current token-only request response and no-DB-access behavior were verified against /api/tag.
SUN behavior preservation: record_sun_tag was inspected as the rule template and TODO scope excludes changing it.
No UID-only path: current app callers do not call record_tag, and the analysis requires the new static path to omit UID handling.
Participant data leak surface: mapper narrowing and tag summary stripping were checked.
Admin-only token exposure: admin route auth and admin live mapper were checked.
Realtime/update behavior: sessions update trigger exists, so switch toggles should notify admin screens without new trigger work.
Next.js route contract: params/searchParams promise behavior and dynamic rendering claim were checked against local Next docs.
